parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood. It provides the overall shape and support for the shelves and doors.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the entire cabinet structure, holding the shelves and doors in place while maintaining rigidity and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that serves as the foundation for other components.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of plywood, used to support stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides surfaces for placing or organizing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but can sometimes be adjustable or removable depending on the design.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a solid wood panel attached to the front of the cabinet, often with a handle for opening and closing.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet interior and protects stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close, providing controlled access to the cabinet interior.
